name: Pi Coding Agent: The SDK Is the Real Reason to Care | Thomas Wiegold Blog
description: I've switched to it for basically everything now. It's dramatically more token-efficient than driving Playwright through an agent, which historically meant dumping enormous DOM snapshots into context and watching the model drown. @tintinweb/pi-subagents. Claude Code style sub-agents.
